g.text: 1. SREF0, SREF1 and SREF2 are separate floating nodes.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #20364b

g.text: Each selector needs its own DC-capable bias/driver.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #20364b

g.text: 2. U1 output return and local bypass capacitors go to RET.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #20364b

g.text: Its logic side stays on GND; isolated bias avoids a bypass.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #20364b

g.text: 3. RS measures combined return / input-inductor current.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #20364b

g.text: It does not measure piezo RMS or QMAIN peak separately.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #20364b

g.text: 4. Keep the chosen selector ON during bursts. Change it

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #20364b

g.text: only after drive stops and measured ring-down ends.
